name: motion-design-director
description: A portable AI skill for original motion-design films, with 50 studies, 24 effect recipes, deterministic helpers, audio and rendering tools.

scripts.demo: node scripts/synth-audio.mjs --output out/offset.wav && node scripts/render.mjs --entry assets/example/index.html --audio out/offset.wav --output out/offset.mp4
scripts.demo:field-notes: node assets/field-notes/synth.mjs out/field-notes.wav && node scripts/render.mjs --entry assets/field-notes/index.html --audio out/field-notes.wav --output out/field-notes.mp4 --width 960 --height 540 --fps 30 --duration 6
